items.name: Government and public institutions
items.challenge: Public institutions need dependable power, secure ICT and transparent procurement that stands up to audit, often across multiple sites and tight budget cycles.
solutions: ZPPA-registered supply of ICT equipment, software and licensing
Solar back-up and lighting for civic buildings
Digital identity and document authentication technology
Fleet electrification studies for public transport and service fleets

items.name: Mining and extractive industries
items.challenge: Remote mine sites face expensive diesel, unstable grid supply and long lead times for critical equipment and spares.
solutions: Hybrid solar PV and lithium storage to cut diesel use
Standby power for offices, camps and control rooms
Sourcing of mining equipment, consumables and heavy vehicles
Electric 4WD pickups and site charging

items.name: Agriculture
items.challenge: Farms and agro-processors need affordable water and power far from the grid, and protection from rising fuel costs.
solutions: Solar water pumping for irrigation and livestock
Solar and storage for cold rooms and processing
Electric utility vehicles and motorcycles for farm logistics

items.name: Manufacturing
items.challenge: Load-shedding and power quality problems interrupt production lines and damage equipment.
solutions: Commercial and industrial solar PV with battery storage
Power distribution, protection and earthing upgrades
Industrial equipment and spares sourcing

items.name: Healthcare
items.challenge: Clinics and hospitals cannot afford power cuts: vaccines, theatres, lighting and records systems depend on uninterrupted supply.
solutions: Solar electrification of rural health posts
Hybrid back-up for critical medical loads
ICT equipment and networks for health facilities

items.name: Education
items.challenge: Universities and schools need safe, well-lit campuses, reliable power and modern ICT for teaching and administration.
solutions: Solar street and car-park lighting
Campus solar PV and back-up power
Computers, networks and Wi-Fi for learning

items.name: Commercial and industrial enterprises
items.challenge: Businesses need to control energy costs, keep systems running and equip their people with reliable technology.
solutions: Rooftop and ground-mount solar PV
Hybrid back-up for offices, hotels and retail
Enterprise ICT, cybersecurity and surveillance
Electric fleet vehicles and workplace charging

items.name: Development organisations
items.challenge: Development programmes need a compliant local partner that can deliver measurable outcomes in rural and underserved areas.
solutions: Rural electrification and mini-grids
Solar for health, water and education facilities
ICT procurement and deployment for programme offices

items.name: Transport and logistics
items.challenge: Fleet operators face volatile fuel prices, high maintenance costs and growing pressure to cut emissions.
solutions: Fleet electrification assessments and TCO modelling
Electric pickups, buses and commercial vehicles
Depot and route charging infrastructure
Heavy commercial vehicles and specialised trucks
